BRITISH FAILED! Sone Bhandar Caves Rajgir | Hidden Treasure MYSTERY
BRITISH FAILED! Welcome to the Sone Bhandar Caves Rajgir, Bihar, a site shrouded in the legend of King Bimbisara’s Hidden Treasure. In this exclusive VLOG, we explore the ancient rock-cut caves, the infamous cannon mark left by the British, and the undeciphered code that guards the gold. This is the ultimate Sone Bhandar Caves Mystery and Full Tour!
